programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: It's the finals of the American Tournament and the Bladebreakers are going head to head with the All Starz with the winner going to the World Championships. In the first round, Tyson is pitted against Steve and at first things don't appear to be going Tyson's way. But with sheer determination, Tyson pulls out a victory that puts the Bladebreakers ahead one to nothing in the best of three finals.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The deciding match of the American Tournament Finals comes down to Max vs. Michael of the 'All Starz,' in a battle that pits science and technology against human spirit. Unfortunately for Max and the Bladebreakers, the trick dish turns out to be a replica of a baseball diamond'where Michael feels right at home!

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: After narrowly defeating the All Starz at the American Tournament, Kenny decides he should record a database of the highs and low points of the BladeBreakers since the very beginning. In fact, through a series of flashbacks, the Chief along with Dizzi, takes a trip down memory lane as far back to the first time he ever met Tyson. With clips from various shows, Kenny narrates the progress of his friends who eventually form the BladeBreakers and go on to the Asian Tournament.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Traveling by boat across the Atlantic, the Bladebreakers must not only deal with Kenny's seasickness, but a gut-wrenching revelation. Tyson's on-board defeat at the hands of a mysterious foe - one wielding a Bit-Beast larger and stronger than any they've ever seen - exposes the team's vulnerability going into the Russian Tournament.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The kids are tricked into missing their boat, forcing them to spend the night in London where a mysterious videotape of Tyson's father is delivered to them. Later, Tyson's Beyblade is stolen and the kids are lured into a fight with the evil Cenotaph and his powerful Bit Beast, Sarcopholon. All seems lost until Kai defeats the mummy by using his own strengths against him. The team agrees to travel by land, learning from every European Beyblader they can find.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: After their train is mysteriously hijacked, the kids find themselves in the dark recesses of a tunnel. This is where the Bladebreakers meet the members of the Dark Bladers! Soon the team is forced into a beyblade match to rescue Kenny from the monsters' evil clutches! But Kenny isn't the only prize in this dark match-up. For if the Bladebreakers lose, their bit-beasts are up for grabs'

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: As the BladeBreakers make their way to the World Championships in Russia, they are stuck in Paris where they end up wasting a day looking for Kai who had mysteriously disappeared. Tyson comes up with the idea of using the Eiffel Tower as a vantage point to speed up their search. Ray, Kenny, Tyson and Max make their way to the observation deck of the tower where they are confronted by the Dark Bladers, a foursome of zombie-like ghouls who have vowed to steal the Bladebreakers Bit Beasts as part of their ultimate plan to capture all Bit Beasts in the world. A massive battle ensues but the odds are against our heroes. Finally, Kai shows up with his newly modified Dranzer and almost single-handedly wins the battle. The Dark Bladers fade away after their humiliating loss and just when you'd think it's over, a mysterious kid named Oliver shows up'

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers spend an extra day in Paris and split up to see the sights. Ray catches up with his uncle, Max goes on a wild shopping spree and Kai goes in search of information. Tyson and Kenny try to see the Louvre but end up Beyblading Oliver, the French Champion. At first Oliver's Bit Beast, Unicolyon, is too much for Dragoon. But Tyson soon proves that even the French Champion has a thing or two to learn about Beyblading.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers arrive in Rome, searching for the mysterious Enrique. Scoffing at their Beyblade challenge, Enrique decides he'd rather spend the day with some of his lady-friends. But Tyson soon convinces him to 'Let it rip!' And after seeing Enrique's personalized BeyStadium, and his outrageous bit-beast, there's a good chance that Tyson may regret his actions'

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Unwilling to let his initial defeat to Enrique faze him, Tyson gets busy reworking his Beyblade. With Enrique having doubts about his own technique, and Oliver visiting him in Rome from France, the stage is set for a rematch. This time, Tyson pits the two heads of Enrique's Bit Beast Amphilyon against each other, and saves Enrique's life when Amphilyon turns on him.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Enrique and Oliver decide to take our heroes on a dirigible ride to visit Robert's castle. The reason - Tyson hopes to avenge an earlier loss to Robert that happened onboard the ship coming to Europe. Tyson's patience, however, is tested when they have to sit and wait for their host who is 'not to be disturbed.' So, Tyson decides to find Robert on his own and ends up getting lost in the medieval castles many eerie secret passages. Finally everyone converges in the room where Robert is playing chess against Johnny and it's here where Tyson throws down the gauntlet and challenges Robert to a rematch. Robert refuses and goes into a whole history lesson about how 'once you've defeated your enemy, the battle is over.' Meanwhile, the arrogant little Johnny decides to pick a battle with the most-worthy opponent in the room and chooses Kai. As the fight begins, it appears to be even, but then Johnny calls out his Bit Beast Salamulyon and totally destroys him. In the end, the Bladebreakers resolve that they have their work cut out for them to become the world champion Beybladers!

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers have made themselves at home at Robert's mansion, refusing to leave unless the Europeans agree to a final Beybattle. To teach his guests a lesson, Robert agrees to a match at his new stadium. But there's one condition: If the Bladebreakers lose, they have to forfeit their berth at the world Championship. Ray and Oliver battle fiercely and the first round ends in a tie. Johnny and Kai, bitter rivals, step to the bowl. But can Kai defeat the man who defeated him?

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Match two gets underway at the Olympia Coliseum, and with a little unsolicited help by his teammates, Kai walks away with a win. The match is tied and the Majestics grudgingly admit to themselves that the only way they'll win the contest is to fight as a team, as the Bladebreakers do. Facing off against Tyson in the final match, will Robert be able to apply the fundamentals of teamwork? And will the Bladebreakers ever discover who sent them on their cross-Europe trip in the first place'?

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers arrive in Moscow on a brisk winter's day in anticipation of the World Beyblading final tournament. As they search for their hotel in the chilly city, they happen upon Boris, a strange man who claims to be the head of a rather eerie Beyblading training center. With the charm of an old world count, Boris invites them to lunch and them brings them to the training facility where they meet the next generation of Beybladers. It's here where Boris decides that one of his pupils should test his blading skills against Tyson.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers run into some old friends in Russia when The All-Starz and the White Tiger Clan show up for an exhibition match. The Beybattle between the two teams ends in a tie and they become fast friends, except for Emily and Mariah, who refuse to speak to each other. Meanwhile, Kai returns to the Abbey to find out why it fills him with foreboding. He discovers a cruel Beyblade facility in the Sub-basements, housing twisted science experiments and an army of children being molded into deadly Beybladers. Kai's lost memories come flooding back as he realizes he was raised in the abbey. But has he discovered the truth too late?

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Kai is torn between escaping the Abbey, and exploring it further in an attempt to unlock forgotten memories from his childhood. The Bladebreakers track down their missing teammate to the Abbey, but are denied access by two of its wunderkind bladers. When Kai discovers the existence of Black Dranzer, the world's most powerful Beyblade, Boris offers it to him - but only if Kai quits the Bladebreakers forever and rejoins the Biovolt Corporation. Flooded with memories of using Black Dranzer as a child, and the lure of its dark, corrupting power leads Kai to a shocking decision.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: It's the first day of the Beyblade World Championships in Moscow, and as our heroes leave their hotel, they still haven't been able to locate Kai who's been missing for some time. Regardless, they arrive at the tournament and meet up with both the White Tigers and the All Starz who invite them to watch their first match against the Demolition Boys. At first things seem fairly normal, that is, until they start to battle. Things go from bad to worse for the All Starz who are no match for the Demolition Boys who quickly go up 2-0 in the best of five events. In the next match, Michael has to square off against a mystery member of the Demolition Boys and it turns out to be none other than Kai who has defected from the Bladebreakers. In the final battle, Kai takes on all the All Starz at once' and wins!! After his victory, he commands the All Starz Bit Beasts to enter his blade and he announces to the world that he now possesses the most powerful Beyblade in the world!!

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Determined to avenge the All-Starz' devastating defeat, the White Tigers face Kai in the Tournament. One by one, they fall before the power of Black Dranzer and watch, horrified, as their Bit Beasts are absorbed into Kai's Beyblade. The Bladebreakers storm the abbey in a desperate attempt to free their teammate. Tyson stumbles into Biovolt's secret lab and learns the truth about Kai's past from a gloating Boris. Tyson refuses to give up on his friend until Kai hands over his old Beyblade and tells him to leave. Will the Bladebreakers survive the loss of their most powerful member?

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Downtrodden and dejected, the Bladebreakers ask themselves over and over again: 'Why would Kai betray us?' Soon enough, however, the boys get a chance to ask him themselves. Summoned by Kai to Beyblade on a frozen lake, the Bladebreakers must not only win to save their Bit Beasts, but must convince Kai that they will always be his teammates. Can they do it'?

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Now that Kai is finally loyal to the 'Bladebreakers,' he returns the Black Dranzer to Boris, doing severe damage to the enemy headquarters in the process. Voltaire orders the operation to proceed, and Boris brings in the Demolition Boys to get the job done. It is revealed that BioVolt is creating a breed of powerful, savage, Bit-Beasts that are designed for War'and the plan is to use them to take over the entire World. The Demolition Boys attack the BBA bus, and Max bravely battles to save his friends. Unfortunately he loses his Bit-Beast, Draciel, in the process'

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers are stranded on the barren Russian Tundra after their run-in with the Demolition Boys when the Majestics mysteriously show up in their bus. After picking our heroes up, they stop at an abandoned palace where Robert challenges Tyson to battle. At first it seems strange that Robert would do this, but Tyson accepts and a battle ensues with Tyson losing two straight. He becomes infuriated! Robert then tells Tyson that he must harness his power back into his blade, which totally confuses Tyson.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The World Championship Finals are finally here and Kai insists on Beybattling first, hoping his knowledge of the Demolition Boys will give him an advantage over Spencer. But in the first set, Seaborg, Spencer's whale Bit Beast, uses the water in the Black Sea Bowl to create a tsunami, which overwhelms Dranzer. Kai is desperate for victory and Voltaire makes him a tempting offer: the power of Black Dranzer in exchange for betraying his friends and stealing their Bit Beasts. Kai stays true to his heart and resists his grandfather.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: After Kai's first round loss to the Demolition Boys in the World Beyblade Finals, it's Ray's turn to take on Bryan in a best-of-three match. Ray learns the hard way that Bryan is a nasty competitor who'll do anything to win - including putting Ray himself through the ringer. When it's discovered that Bryan's attack includes the ability to manipulate air itself into a weapon, Ray faces a troubling realization. To negate Bryan's fury, he must put his own well being at risk. But Ray's Bit-Beast Driger has other ideas, and it offers up selfless act of its own.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: After a devastating match puts Ray in the hospital, Tyson trains his heart out to prepare for his battle against Tala, leader of the Demolition Boys. What Tyson doesn't know is that Tala has become one of Boris' weird experiments, uploaded with dangerous Biovolt technology. Meanwhile, Max's parents work together to come up with an improved Beyblade that can combat the existing threat of the Demolition Boys' prowess. Can it even come close to competing against'Cyber-Tala?

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: It is the finals of the World Beyblading Championships in Moscow with Tala from the Demolition Boys and Tyson tied at one game a piece in the best of three finals. With the victory, the tide has turned in favor of Tala who warps the two warriors into a giant iceberg where there is no contact with the outside world. The second battle begins, and it takes little time for Tala to combine his multiple Bit Beasts into one and take the lead in the best of three finals. Meanwhile, the evil Voltaire, head of the Biovolt Corporation looks on and begins celebrating the victory, which translates into his domination of the corporate world.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Tyson is at home practicing martial arts with his grandfather when suddenly he realizes he's late for a Beyblade battle with Andrew. As he runs out of his house he's confronted by a couple of bullies who only slow him up for his real battle. But when Tyson does show up, Andrew and his friends are met by a smart mouthed kid named Carlos who's a member of the notorious Blade Sharks. Carlos challenges anyone to a battle but the winner gets to keep the others Beyblades. Tyson accepts. With the help of Kenny and his Bit Beast Dizzi, who's trapped inside his laptop, Tyson prepares for the big battle, which he handily wins. But the just when the fight is over, the Blade Shark's leader Kai shows up and a new battle begins between Kai and Tyson

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Tyson battles Kai one on one, but to his surprise, Tyson quickly loses. The Chief informs Tyson, that in order to beat Kai, you need a strategy, so Tyson goes home in an attempt to practice until he's perfected his fighting technique. Later that day, Andrew and Kenny, along with Dizzi show up and attempt to increase the power of Tyson's blade to match that of Kai, but with little success. Tyson is feeling glum about his chances of ever beating Kai, but suddenly, out of nowhere, the Bit Beast Dragoon appears and flies straight towards him and goes directly into Tyson's beyblade. Tyson is stunned after realizing Dragoon does exists and is now inside his beyblade. With renewed confidence, Tyson knows the time is right to challenge Kai once again to do battle.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: In a moment of heroism, Max, the new Beyblader in town, shows Tyson that with the proper skill and training, there is nothing that can't be achieved. The two soon become fast friends, leaving Kenny feeling left out.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The Beyblade Regional Qualifying Tournament is underway as Tyson, Max, Ray and even Kenny are entered to see if they can dethrone Kai, the reigning champion. As our announcers, Brad Best and A.J. Topper rev up the crowd, Kenny is first into battle but without a Bit Beast in his blade, he falls quickly to Kai.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Max is completely overpowered in his semi-finals match against Kai. It's not until the Bit Beast known as Draciel emerges from Max's Grandmother's pendant, to add its power to Max's Beyblade that the tables begin to turn.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The Qualifying Tournament is in its final stages as Tyson has advanced to face Ray in the semi-finals. As the best of three battles gets underway, Tyson's bravado quickly fades as Ray handily wins the first round when he destroys Tyson's Beyblade with his famous Tiger Claw Attack.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The National Beyblade Championship Match is set, with Tyson facing off against reigning champion, Kai. It's not until Grandpa throws a surprise party for Tyson, that the rookie sensation realizes he's forgotten his own Birthday!

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Tyson and his team prepare for the Hong Kong world championships. Kai seems to reject his newfound team and leads them on a chase through the streets. That's where the guys learn some lessons about Beyblading from some very mysterious 'bladers. After a decisive victory, Tyson and the gang discover that the alley bladders make up the membership of 'The White Tiger Team'' Whatever that is'

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Our heroes arrive in Hong Kong on a stop-over to the Asian Beyblade Tournament when they run into Ray's old gang the White Tigers. A confrontation quickly ensues with no one coming out the clear winner.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The first round of the Asian Tournament sees the Bladebreakers facing off against the team called the Tall-Boys, with Ray's ex-teammates, The White Tigers, waiting in the wings.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The night before the Asian Tournament, Kevin decides to steal data from Kenny's laptop to get the edge for his White Tiger Team. Unfortunately, Kenny catches him red-handed which sets up a battle between Ray and Kevin, which ends in dire consequences for Ray.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: After realizing his Bit Beast is gone, Ray decides to head for the mountains in an attempt to get it back. Tyson and Mariah give chase and confront Ray to decide which team he wants to be on.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The White Tiger Team faces off against the Spin-Shepards in the quarterfinals of the Asian Tournament. When Ray sees that Lee is also using the 'Tiger Claw' attack, he is forced to finally open up to his teammates about his mysterious past.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: It's the morning of the semi-finals at the Asian Beyblade Tournament and Tyson manages to sleep in. The rest of the team leaves early, but Ray stays behind to make sure Tyson wakes up. As the tournament gets underway, Max is the first to battle. Meanwhile, Ray and Tyson are caught up in a traffic jam created by a landslide, so they decide to walk. But the shortest route is over a mountain where Ray sprains his ankle and Tyson is left to carrying him all the way to there.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The finals are about to begin in the Asian Qualifying Tournament with the winning team advancing to the World Beyblading Championships. In the first round, Max goes against Gary from the White Tigers in a best of three battle. The first round goes without a hitch as Max easily takes care of his opponent and with the win, Max becomes a little over confident.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: During the finals of the Asian Tournament, Ray faces off against his old teammate, and former friend, Mariah. When Galux and Driger team up to show the pair a glimpse of the happiness they shared in the past, Ray and Mariah come to realize how much they have lost, by being rivals.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The final match of the Asian Beyblade Tournament reaches an uncertain conclusion when Tyson and Lee's decisive battle ends in a draw. The resulting sudden death session between Ray and Lee rekindles the pair's old hometown grievances.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Fresh from the Bladebreakers win in Asia, Tyson comes home and realizes he's front page news! With his ego out of control, Tyson takes on the attitude of a rock star, which upsets Kenny who tries to keep him focused on blading and not his popularity. Meanwhile, at a local playground, the local kids are all out Beyblading when Tyson spots a kid (Nicky), being smoked in the Beystadium by a bully (Riley). After Nicky's blade is completely destroyed, Tyson vows to help the kid fix it and fight his way back.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers arrive in the USA for the American Tournament. During a tour of a BBA research facility, Max is shocked to learn that his Mom works there, and not at the college, like he thought. To make matters worse, the team discovers that they are being tested for weaknesses, by a competing team.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: After their non-competition loss to Emily of the All Starz at the BBA Research Center, the Blade Breakers sneak around the high-tech facility, hoping to learn more about their competition. There, they confront two other All Starz, and Max learns more about his Mom's job at the BBA - specifically, a rumor of why Max wasn't asked to join the All Starz Team.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: For some strange reason, Mr. Dickenson has sent the Blade Breakers to a remote mountain retreat to hone their blading skills for the upcoming American Tournament as well as to get Kenny and Dizzi to figure out a way to increase Ray's Bit Beast's power. Once there, they meet up with a enthusiastic young boy named Antonio who they think is there to train them. Turns out, Antonio is a pathetic blader.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: A charity event in the Heartland of America gives the Bladebreakers a taste of the All Starz' prowess. Featuring celebrities in a three-on-three contest against young Beybladers of note, Emily of the All Starz, bullies her way to an easy win. It isn't until Emily knocks out her own opponent, loses the second match and is on her way to throwing the whole competition, that Max teaches her what teamwork is all about.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers arrive in Las Vegas for the start of the American Tournament. Tyson looks forward to facing off against the arrogant All-Starz, and their scientifically advanced Beyblades'but first his team needs to get past the 'Renegades' in the qualifying round. Kai surprises everyone by stepping into the dish for the first battle!

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The Blade Breakers have advanced to the second round of the American Tournament where they square off against the Savage Slammers. The winner of this round advances to the semi-finals. Their competition first appears to be a bunch of slackers, but when Ray loses out in the first round, they quickly realize what they're up against. Max is next, and for some odd reason, his rival folds under pressure, so the best of three is tied at one a piece with Tyson coming in for the deciding battle.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: It's the Bladebreakers versus Spintensity in the semi-finals of the American Tournament. But before the match can begin, Tyson is forced to withdraw with a stomachache he got from too much celebratory eating. Max, Ray and Kai must drag race their crafty foes through the whirlwind, highway-themed dish called the New Jersey Turnpike.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Tensions rise as the American Tournament heats up. Max fights for a chance to beyblade against his mother's team the All-Starz in an upcoming match, while Tyson and the rest of the Bladebreakers realize that the All-Starz are a bigger threat then they previously thought. At the end of two tense rounds, Tyson and Steven are tied one-all'

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: It's the finals of the American Tournament and the Bladebreakers are going head to head with the All Starz with the winner going to the World Championships. In the first round, Tyson is pitted against Steve and at first things don't appear to be going Tyson's way. But with sheer determination, Tyson pulls out a victory that puts the Bladebreakers ahead one to nothing in the best of three finals.

programme.desc: After their train is mysteriously hijacked, the kids find themselves in the dark recesses of a tunnel. This is where the Bladebreakers meet the members of the Dark Bladers! Soon the team is forced into a beyblade match to rescue Kenny from the monsters' evil clutches! But Kenny isn't the only prize in this dark match-up. For if the Bladebreakers lose, their bit-beasts are up for grabs'

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: As the BladeBreakers make their way to the World Championships in Russia, they are stuck in Paris where they end up wasting a day looking for Kai who had mysteriously disappeared. Tyson comes up with the idea of using the Eiffel Tower as a vantage point to speed up their search. Ray, Kenny, Tyson and Max make their way to the observation deck of the tower where they are confronted by the Dark Bladers, a foursome of zombie-like ghouls who have vowed to steal the Bladebreakers Bit Beasts as part of their ultimate plan to capture all Bit Beasts in the world. A massive battle ensues but the odds are against our heroes. Finally, Kai shows up with his newly modified Dranzer and almost single-handedly wins the battle. The Dark Bladers fade away after their humiliating loss and just when you'd think it's over, a mysterious kid named Oliver shows up'

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers spend an extra day in Paris and split up to see the sights. Ray catches up with his uncle, Max goes on a wild shopping spree and Kai goes in search of information. Tyson and Kenny try to see the Louvre but end up Beyblading Oliver, the French Champion. At first Oliver's Bit Beast, Unicolyon, is too much for Dragoon. But Tyson soon proves that even the French Champion has a thing or two to learn about Beyblading.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers arrive in Rome, searching for the mysterious Enrique. Scoffing at their Beyblade challenge, Enrique decides he'd rather spend the day with some of his lady-friends. But Tyson soon convinces him to 'Let it rip!' And after seeing Enrique's personalized BeyStadium, and his outrageous bit-beast, there's a good chance that Tyson may regret his actions'

programme.title: BLEACH the Movie 4 : Hell Verse [English Dub]
programme.desc: Ichigo must travel into the depths of Hell to stop a group of vicious Sinners and save his younger sister Yuzu, unaware that his actions could bring Hell to the World of the Living.

programme.title: Naruto the Movie: Ninja Clash in the Land of Snow [English Dub]
programme.desc: Naruto and his team are sent on a mission to guard Yukie Fujikaze, a popular actress starring in the hit movie "The Adventures of Princess Gale."

programme.title: Naruto the Movie 2 : Legend of the Stone of Gelel [English Dub]
programme.desc: Drawn into a fierce struggle over the legendary Stone of Gelel, Naruto, Shikamaru, and Sakura must keep the stone from falling into the wrong hands.

programme.title: Naruto the Movie 3 : Guardians of the Crescent Moon Kingdom [English Dub]
programme.desc: Naruto, Sakura, and Kakashi team up with Rock Lee to escort Prince Michiru and his son Hikaru, but a villainous uprising awaits their homecoming.

programme.title: Demon Slayer -Kimetsu no Yaiba- The Movie: Mugen Train [English Dub]
programme.desc: Tanjiro and Nezuko, along with Zenitsu and Inosuke, join one of the most powerful swordsmen within the Demon Slayer Corps, Flame Hashira Kyojuro Rengoku, to face the demon aboard the Mugen Train on track to despair.

programme.title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 [English Dub]
programme.desc: Political fixer Pomade Jaws trusts no one, not even his wife Laura. He's stored the scandalous secrets of various world leaders inside a voice-activated safe.

programme.title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 [English Dub]
programme.desc: Lupin, Jigen and Goemon have turned themselves in to the FBI, but it's all part of the plan. Their real goal is to break out old man Clyde Barlow, who was once known as a genius bank robber, to get his help with their heist of the National Super Bank.

programme.title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 [English Dub]
programme.desc: Isami Kondo III, grandson of the leader of the Shinsengumi, hires Lupin and his gang to recover a golden cannon sunk by the Shogunate forces in the Tsugaru Strait. After much effort, the valuable golden cannon is finally recovered from the deep ocean.

programme.title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 [English Dub]
programme.desc: Ellery Queen, the owner of the legendary sapphire called "The Eye of Solomon," is also the owner of a football team. Lupin, coming for the sapphire as announced, discovers Queen on the brink of death.

programme.title: Sonic X
programme.desc: As Tails is given a hero's welcome after saving Station Square from Eggman's missile attack, Gamma decides to deprogram the mission given to him by Dr. Eggman and assigns himself a new one: to find his E-series brothers and to rescue their animals.

programme.title: Sonic X
programme.desc: Dr. Eggman reveals to Sonic that he had been double-crossed by Chaos. As Knuckles warns Sonic of dangers of Chaos if he was to obtain the last Chaos Emerald, they are transported to the past by a mysterious red orb.

programme.title: Beelzebub [English Dub]
programme.desc: Aoi is still flustered from her encounter with Hilda and Baby Beel in Oga's body, and the other Red Tails are worried about her. In order to get her to rejoin the Red Tails, they gather at her family's shrine for a meeting, but a rival gang from West Kanto shows up to take them down!

programme.title: Beelzebub [English Dub]
programme.desc: All the gang is trapped in school as a fierce snowstorm blows outside... One by one, they are beaten up, in exactly the situation of a legendary counting song, 100 Delinquents... Who is the evil bastard that's behind all this?

programme.title: INUYASHIKI LAST HERO [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Ichiro Inuyashiki is a boring office worker who looks like an old man. Even after building them a new home, his family is nothing but ungrateful. One day, Inuyashiki is diagnosed with terminal cancer. Out on a walk to clear his head, a UFO crashes into him, and his body is rebuilt into a deadly robot. He steps in to stop a group of kids from torturing a homeless man when he is knocked unconscious.

programme.title: INUYASHIKI LAST HERO [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Reborn a robot, Inuyashiki finds meaning by saving others. Meanwhile, high school student Hiro Shishigami has also been reborn a robot. Shishigami has no regard for anybody aside from his best friend and his family, and uses his robot powers to kill indiscriminately. Contrary to Inuyashiki, he feels alive when he is taking the lives of others. What happens when these two meet?

programme.title: Magic Kaito 1412 [English Dub]
programme.desc: Kaito takes a break from thieving to go on his class ski trip, but when his teacher holds a couples-only masquerade ski tournament, he finds himself in a tug-of-war between the witchy Akako and childhood friend Aoko!

programme.title: Magic Kaito 1412 [English Dub]
programme.desc: Kaito and Aoko are on a luxury train with the Queen of Ingram, her son, and the Principality of Ingram's Crystal Mother, a huge topaz that may contain the Pandora jewel. The queen has the real jewel cleverly hidden, though, making it a challenge for Kaito/Kid to find it before the train reaches Osaka. On top of that, he's got competition, as there's a Snake on the train!

programme.desc: When a princess with a priceless jewel comes to town, Inspector Nakamori is sidelined by a detective from her country who shoots first and... shoots again later, until his quarry is killed. Naturally, his target is Kid the Phantom Thief!

programme.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood [English Dub]

programme.title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 [English Dub]
programme.desc: The world's largest diamond has been discovered in South Africa and Lupin has his eyes on the prize. But as it turns out, stealing it is the easy part!

programme.title: Sonic X
programme.desc: As he hacks GUN's computer database, Dr. Eggman discovers his grandfather's mysterious "Ultimate Life Form" project named Shadow.

programme.title: Sonic X
programme.desc: Sonic is accused of causing havoc in Prison Island. As GUN agents seek after Sonic, Sonic attempts to figure out who had framed him.

programme.title: Beelzebub [English Dub]
programme.desc: Oga Tatsumi is a first year student in Ishiyama High, a notorious school for delinquents. One day he sees a man floating by, and the man suddenly splits in half to reveal a baby boy inside!

programme.title: Beelzebub [English Dub]
programme.desc: Black Baby Beel disappears from the teacher's office, and the only clue they have is that some super-hot boy with beautiful hair was seen running off with it. Meanwhile, Himekawa is skipping school and... buying baby care supplies?

programme.title: INUYASHIKI LAST HERO [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Shishigami is rattled to see Inuyashiki stand up from a blow that should have killed him before flying away. Meanwhile, Shishigami confronts a group of delinquents who have been tormenting his best friend Naoyuki Ando.

programme.title: INUYASHIKI LAST HERO [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: When the fully tattooed yakuza criminal Samejima finds a girl he likes, he kidnaps them, drugs them up, and then roughs them up. Fumino was happy. She had a job and a fiance. Inuyashiki comes to save them, but gets shot.

programme.title: Magic Kaito 1412 [English Dub]
programme.desc: When a princess with a priceless jewel comes to town, Inspector Nakamori is sidelined by a detective from her country who shoots first and... shoots again later, until his quarry is killed. Naturally, his target is Kid the Phantom Thief!

programme.title: Magic Kaito 1412 [English Dub]
programme.desc: Kid the Phantom Thief literally rises to the occasion when old man Jirokichi of the Suzuki conglomerate throws down the gauntlet. But with Detective Conan as part of the security team guarding the Blue Wonder jewel, will Kaito finally get his wings clipped?

programme.title: Magic Kaito 1412 [English Dub]
programme.desc: Kid's next target is Green Dream, the world's largest emerald and a one-time-only stage prop for a local play. Though the venue is crawling with cops under Nakamori's command, will Kid be able to make off with Green Dream as well as make a young actress's dream come true?

programme.title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 [English Dub]

programme.title: Baselines
programme.desc: Set in Los Angeles, this series follows Jamiel Chambers, a blue chip high-schooler on the brink of escaping the desperate poverty that has berated inner city America. After his junior year ends with him leading his team to a second place finish in the state's regional tournament, Jamiel is hand-picked to play in the city's annual summer league All-Star game. With college recruits swarming and pro agents hedging, the media circus leans in, peddling the question mark around his future like rabid bookies. It is this exposure that gets the attention of Nick Collins, a derelict from a disreputable family from neighboring Irvine. After his doomed-from-the-start plan to capitalize on Jamiel's notoriety ends in with fatal results, family members from both sides are pulled into a series of events which will not only effect Jamiel's trajectory, but will set up one of the most intense family feuds the city has ever witnessed.

programme.desc: Rick llega a caballo a Atlanta, donde encuentra una ciudad desolada. Tras escapar de una situación de peligro, Rick se une a un grupo de supervivientes en unos grandes almacenes, donde le espera un enemigo más peligroso que los zombis.

programme.title: The Walking Dead

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Tras el ataque al campamento, Rick conduce al grupo hacia el CDC, un recinto de la base sanitaria militar, en el que esperan encontrar un refugio seguro. Durante el trayecto, Jim debe tomar una decisión extremadamente difícil.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Un científico inquietante deja entrar a Rick y su grupo en el CDC. No obstante, hay algo extraño y los supervivientes del apocalipsis zombi empiezan a sospechar que no todo es lo que parece en el recinto.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: El grupo, liderado por Rick, se topa con una horda de zombis en mitad de la autopista. La pequeña Sophia, asustada, huye sola al bosque y todos tratarán de encontrarla antes de que sea demasiado tarde.

programme.title: The Walking Dead

programme.title: The Walking Dead

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Shane regresa a la granja con las medicinas, pero el sacrificio que ha tenido que cometer no es bien visto por el resto del grupo. En la granja, el grupo intenta sacar a un zombi del pozo de agua fresca antes de que la infecte.

programme.title: The Walking Dead

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: En Atlanta, una banda armada sorprende al grupo de Rick mientras están buscando a Merle. Entretanto, en el campamento, Jim empieza a comportarse de forma extraña, tiene premoniciones y asusta a los niños con una tragedia que se aproxima.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Tras el ataque al campamento, Rick conduce al grupo hacia el CDC, un recinto de la base sanitaria militar, en el que esperan encontrar un refugio seguro. Durante el trayecto, Jim debe tomar una decisión extremadamente difícil.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Un científico inquietante deja entrar a Rick y su grupo en el CDC. No obstante, hay algo extraño y los supervivientes del apocalipsis zombi empiezan a sospechar que no todo es lo que parece en el recinto.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: El grupo, liderado por Rick, se topa con una horda de zombis en mitad de la autopista. La pequeña Sophia, asustada, huye sola al bosque y todos tratarán de encontrarla antes de que sea demasiado tarde.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Rick encuentra una granja en la que buscar ayuda para salvar la vida de su hijo, quien recibió el impacto accidental de una bala. Después, Shane entra en una escuela llena de zombis para llevarse material sanitario junto al tipo que disparó a Carl.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Shane y Otis están atrapados por los zombis en la escuela adonde acudieron por el material sanitario necesario para operar a Carl. En la granja, surgen las primeras tensiones y Daryl y Andrea vuelven a salir en busca de Sophie.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Shane regresa a la granja con las medicinas, pero el sacrificio que ha tenido que cometer no es bien visto por el resto del grupo. En la granja, el grupo intenta sacar a un zombi del pozo de agua fresca antes de que la infecte.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Mientras busca a Sophia, Daryl sufre un accidente que lo deja perdido y herido en el bosque. La tensión entre el grupo y los propietarios de la granja aumenta, así como la inestabilidad del propio grupo, debido a que Shane desafía a Rick.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Tras descubrir que la familia mantiene encerrada a sus familiares convertidos en zombis en el granero, Dale confronta a Hershel. Lori, por su parte, confiesa a Rick que está embarazada y los problemas entre los integrantes del grupo se intensifican.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Glenn le revela a todo el grupo el secreto del granero, pero no están de acuerdo sobre cómo actuar: Rick ordena respetar la autoridad de Hershel, aunque Shane quiere acabar con los zombis. Por otra parte, descubren por fin qué le ha pasado a Sophia.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Hershel no soporta lo ocurrido y recae en su alcoholismo, pero Rick y Glenn lo siguen hasta la ciudad para evitar que muera. Entretanto, Beth, incapaz de aceptar todo lo que le está sucediendo a su familia, entra en estado catatónico.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Lori sale en busca de Rick, pero lo único que encuentra es un peligro mortal y Shane va tras ella. Entretanto, Rick, Hershel y Glenn mantienen un tiroteo con los desconocidos con quienes cruzaron sus caminos en el bar.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: La tensión entre Rick y Shane aumenta y la decisión sobre el destino de Randall es el detonante: Shane quiere matarlo, Rick prefiere dejarlo vivo. Mientras, Beth pretende suicidarse y Andrea, quien debe vigilarla, no cumple con su cometido.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: El grupo descubre que Randall es un violador y asesino y acuerdan ejecutarlo, pero Dale se opone porque eso los convertiría también en criminales. Mientras tanto, Carl comete un error que acarreará consecuencias imprevistas.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Las diferencias entre Rick y Shane por el liderato del grupo y la gestión de la granja se intensifican cuando Shane decide por su cuenta el destino de Randall. La tensión termina estallando y los dos amigos se enfrentan a muerte.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Una horda de zombis invade la granja y el grupo intenta escapar vivo entre el caos, pero no todos lo lograrán. Además, Rick se harta de las quejas del grupo y les da un ultimátum: si quieren que sea el líder, acatarán sus órdenes.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: El grupo encuentra refugio en las instalaciones de una prisión federal abandonada tras meses en la carretera. Rick considera que se trata de un lugar seguro para que Lori pase los últimos meses de embarazo, pero quizá se haya equivocado.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Rick accede a dejar salir de sus celdas a los prisioneros si les ayudan a matar a los zombis que quedan en la prisión. Entretanto, la salud de Hershel empeora por momentos.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Andrea y Michonne descubren una comunidad de sobrevivientes liderada por un hombre llamado el Gobernador. Allá les ofrecen medicinas, comida, agua caliente y ropa limpia, pero Michonne desconfía del Gobernador y sus verdaderas intenciones.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: En Woodbury, Michonne desconfía del Gobernador y planea irse sin Andrea. En la prisión, un sabotaje provoca que una horda de zombis penetre en la cárcel y, mientras Rick y sus compañeros los combaten, Lori entra en trabajo de parto.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Rick está totalmente abatido por la muerte de Lori, pero recibe una llamada telefónica sorprendente. Entretanto, Michonne ha descubierto el secreto del Gobernador y se dispone a abandonar Woodbury, a pesar de que Andrea quiere permanecer allá.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Michonne ve a Glenn y Maggie buscando provisiones, pero alguien más los observa: Merle, quien reconoce a Glenn como uno de los que le abandonó, a merced de los zombis, en una azotea de Atlanta. Entretanto, Rick sigue mentalmente inestable.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Michonne conduce a Rick, Daryl y Oscar a Woodbury para rescatar a Glenn y Maggie, a quienes el Gobernador está torturando para sonsacarles dónde se oculta el grupo de Rick.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: El grupo de Rick invade Woodbury con la intención de rescatar a Glenn y Maggie. Michonne descubre el secreto familiar que oculta el Gobernador cuando trata de asesinarlo. En la prisión, un grupo desconocido atraviesa la verja de seguridad.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Rick y Maggie regresan a Woodbury para salvar a Daryl, quien está obligado a luchar contra su hermano. Entretanto, en la prisión, el grupo de Rick se encuentra con el grupo de Sasha y Tyreese.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: En secreto, el Gobernador y sus hombres preparan una incursión mortal contra la prisión. Darryl y Merle llegan en mitad de la contienda.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: El Gobernador permite a Andrea, acompañada de Milton, ir a la prisión a negociar la paz con su antiguo grupo. Mientras, Tyreese y Sasha llegan a Woodbury y le ofrecen al Gobernador información sobre la prisión a cambio de poder quedarse allá.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Rick, Michonne y Carl viajan al condado de Rick en busca de armamento y encuentran a alguien a quien creían muerto. Durante la misión, Rick cambia la percepción que tiene de Michonne.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Andrea concierta un encuentro entre Rick y el Gobernador para que negocien la paz, pero el Gobernador exige la cabeza de Michonne a cambio del alto el fuego.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Henry encuentra a Lydia, pero Beta, la mano derecha de Alpha, lo captura. En Alejandría, Michonne discute con el consejo si deben participar en la feria con el resto de las comunidades.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Daryl, Connie, Henry y Lydia se ocultan en un edificio para tenderle una trampa a Beta. Mientras tanto, el Reino sufre la amenaza de un grupo de extorsionistas que patrulla las carreteras y exige dinero a cambio de transitar por ellas.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Se descubre el espeluznante origen de las misteriosas cicatrices que Michonne y Daryl lucen en la espalda, el motivo por el cual la actitud de Michonne hacia los forasteros cambió tanto desde la desaparición de Rick.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Por primera vez en años, las cuatro comunidades se reúnen durante la feria que organiza el Reino. Alpha aprovecha la ocasión para infiltrarse de incógnito entre los visitantes de la feria.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Se desata una tormenta de nieve terrible que sorprende al grupo de Ezekiel viajando hacia Hilltop. Su única esperanza reside en cruzar la frontera que estableció Alpha y acortar el trayecto a través del territorio que tienen prohibido pisar.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: En Oceanside, el grupo continúa entrenando en caso de que los Susurradores regresen. Las tensiones aumentan, mientras los supervivientes tratan de aferrarse a lo que queda en pie de su concepto de civilización.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Se revela el origen de Alpha y Beta. Además, Alpha intenta endurecer a Lydia a medida que se preparan para caminar junto a los muertos, y los Susurradores crean sus hordas.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: La creciente amenaza del regreso de los Susurradores dispara la paranoia en Alejandría. Además, Carol lucha contra su sed de venganza.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Los habitantes de Alejandría están paranoicos y enloquecidos con los Susurradores. Además, de regreso en la Colonia Hilltop, un grupo lidia con un inesperado problema de seguridad.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Desaparecen provisiones de Hilltop. Además, un habitante de Alejandría idolatra a Negan. Ezekiel guarda un secreto.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Carol y Daryl emprenden una misión juntos. Mientras tanto, Siddiq intenta resolver un misterio.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Carol provoca que Daryl se sienta absolutamente incómodo. Alpha y Beta tienen dudas sobre una persona.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Una pelea causa tensiones en Oceanside mientras los habitantes de Alejandría se embarcan en una misión de alto riesgo.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: El grupo debe averiguar cómo salir de una situación peligrosa.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: El grupo debe defender a Alejandría de una fuerza amenazante.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Tras el encuentro de Daryl y Lydia con Alpha, los habitantes de las comunidades enfrentadas a los Susurradores, que se aproximan a la Cumbre, tienen dos opciones: huir o pelear. Entretanto, surgen problemas entre Eugene y Stephanie.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Michonne lleva a Virgil de regreso a su misteriosa isla para reunirse con su familia. A cambio, Virgil promete armas que podrían cambiar el rumbo de la Guerra de los Susurradores.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Michonne devuelve a Virgil a la isla misteriosa de la que proviene para que se reencuentre con su familia. A cambio, Virgil promete que le entregará un arsenal que cambiará el rumbo de la guerra contra los Susurradores.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Todos, héroes y villanos, se adaptan a las consecuencias del devastador incendio que destruyó la comunidad. Eugene encabeza a un grupo que parte en busca de Stephanie, guiados por la esperanza de encontrar otra civilización.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Princesa asusta a los caballos de Eugene, Yumiko y Ezequiel, pero les promete otro medio de transporte. Mientras, Beta, en estado de delirio psicótico, guía a la horda de zombis hacia Alejandría para destruirlo todo.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Los seguidores de Beta se acercan a las puertas, y parte del grupo se impregna de sangre de zombi para intentar escapar entre la multitud de caminantes y regresar con ayuda. Sin embargo, los susurradores se mueven con cuchillos entre los zombis.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Maggie regresa, para consternación de Negan. Los desafíos que superó desde su partida han hecho que se vuelva difícil sobrevivir para ella y su hijo. Por otro lado, Daryl y Maggie luchan inesperadamente contra una amenaza invisible y desconocida.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Daryl y Carol encuentran una vieja cabaña que provoca que Daryl recuerde sus años alejados del grupo después de que Rick desapareció. Además, revive el doloroso recuerdo de encontrarse con un sobreviviente y los eventos tóxicos con Dog.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Maggie, Gabriel y Aarón buscan comida y suministros para llevarlos de regreso a Alejandría, utilizando el mapa de Maggie. En su búsqueda de una ubicación más, encuentran un escondite, pero la fe se rompe y el optimismo se resquebraja.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Eugene, Ezekiel, Yumiko y Princess son capturados y separados por los misteriosos soldados que los rodeaban en la estación ferroviaria. Princess lucha con los recuerdos de su traumático pasado y planea escapar.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Daryl y Carol toman caminos separados. Ella regresa a Alejandría, mientras él se adentra en los bosques. A partir de este momento, cada uno deberá usar sus habilidades de supervivencia.

programme.desc: Maggie vuelve a Alejandría mientras Carol lleva a Negan a un viaje para minimizar la tensión en aumento. Negan reflexiona sobre su difunta esposa Lucille.

programme.title: Animals
programme.desc: Pol is a teenager with a seemingly calm life. He lives with his brother, and is still in high school. However, Pol has a secret: Deerhoof, a cuddly teddy bear who thinks, moves around, and with whom he shares his best moments. Life goes on as normal until the arrival of Ikari, an enigmatic student who seems to be hiding something.

programme.title: Alongside Night
programme.desc: In a collapsing near-future U.S., brilliant high-school senior Elliot Vreeland's search for his famous missing economist father and family puts him between an out-of-control federal government and a revolutionary anarchist underground. Starring Kevin Sorbo, Christian Kramme and Reid Cox.

programme.title: Beeper
programme.desc: A doctor must follow the instructions on a drug dealer's beeper to rescue his kidnapped son. Starring Harvey Keitel, Joey Lauren Adams, Ed Quinn

programme.title: Bartleby
programme.desc: A clueless boss has no idea what to do with his mundane office worker whose refusal of duties only gets worse each passing minute. Star studded cast!!

programme.title: Ashes
programme.desc: After the death of his beloved wife in a devastating fire, Jonathon Soter's life is in ruins. Drinking to excess and barely holding down his job as a teacher, he's a man lost with nothing to live for. But the sudden news that the boy who killed his wife, Donald McKinley, has been released early from prison, brings monumental change for Soter and gives him a new motivation. He begins a journey where he hopes to find his tormentor, to find an answer and perhaps to ultimately find redemption.

programme.title: Bait
programme.desc: Two women with aspirations of opening their own business borrow money from a loan shark, but when his terms turn violent, they're forced into bloody retaliation.

programme.title: Apotheosis
programme.desc: Darwin and his girlfriend Christine get into an angry fight one night. The next day she is found dead in a dumpster. Darwin is accused of the crime. But what really happened? It could be only his shadow knows the truth.

programme.title: Amateur Teens
programme.desc: A group of average students at a secondary school in Zürich wrestle with the average teenager’s needs: love and acceptance. But when the growing influence of social media tosses them into the grown-up world of sexuality and aggression, their needs turn dangerous. What follows is a tragedy that blurs the lines between perpetrator and victim, guilt and innocence.

programme.title: Anthem
programme.desc: A young writer and his attractive wife looking to climb the social ladder move to an affluent area outside of Scottsdale AZ. Little do they know...Once you say yes... it's hard to say no later.

programme.title: An Honest Liar
programme.desc: The incredible true story of the renowned magician turned skeptic and exposer of frauds and hoaxes, James The Amazing Randi. Starring James Randi, Alice Cooper and Penn and Teller

programme.title: Bled White
programme.desc: The dead feast on human flesh and stop at nothing for it. The living, confined to the dark corners of the world, must do what it takes to survive.

programme.title: Elizabeth Blue
programme.desc: Anna Schafer plays Elizabeth, a young woman struggling with schizophrenia. With the help of her Psychiatrist (Screen Actors Guild Award Winner Adewale Akinnuoye-Agbaje) Elizabeth is doing her best to navigate voices, hallucinations, anxiety, failing medications and her unsupportive mother .

programme.title: Ever After Reloaded
programme.desc: A young, straight laced police detective, Jack Carrouseau, inadvertently crosses paths with a mysterious assassin named Miko. Despite requests to end the pursuit, he continues to investigate, and uncovers a trail of blood and death stretching from the beaches of Southern California to the inner boroughs of Washington DC.

programme.title: Food Sail Love
programme.desc: In this, the final episode, we sail along the French Riviera and catch up with some of the people and places we know and love. This region is particularly dear to Patrick; he was born in Marseille and spent all of his childhood summers on this coast. First, we’ll visit St Tropez, including the iconic Club 55; then we’ll take you to Antibes and to a couple of nearby villages, St Paul de Vence and Biot. Each has a restaurant which we count among our favourites, and they have two things in common – traditional Provençal food… and art, which in each case is largely its raison d’être.

programme.title: Food Sail Love
programme.desc: In our first episode, you find us at a boatyard in the small fishing town of Chioggia - at the southern end of the Venice Lagoon, preparing the yacht for its voyage. We will show you around this lovely town, and introduce you to some of the colourful people we’ve come to know here over the years. Chioggia is the busiest fishing port on all of mainland Italy; we will take you to its fish markets, and meet a restaurateur in the kitchen of one of Chioggia’s finest restaurants to see the chefs cook some local specialties. We also go fishing with a father and son, who practice an ancient tradition of net and pole fishing on the Venetian Lagoon. They are called moecanti.

programme.title: Food Sail Love
programme.desc: In this second episode, we sail into Venice and visit our friend Renato, who has been the head chef at the Cipriani Hotel for over 25 years and has travelled the world as a food ambassador. Renato invites us into his kitchen to make some of his best-loved Venetian dishes. We then visit the famous Rialto markets and cook a few of my favourites in the yacht’s galley. We conclude our Venice adventure by visiting some friends at an old gondola repair yard called a squero. It has been converted into a private retreat featuring an impressive kitchen, from which we experience a memorable Venetian cook-up.

programme.title: Food Sail Love
programme.desc: In this episode, we sail all the way to southern Turkey to visit the picturesque village of Kaleköy in the Kekova area. We introduce you to a local family who run the Likya restaurant, and serve simple delicious Turkish food. We’ve known them for over 30 years, ever since we began sailing here. We also discover how the locals love the carob bean, and how they make a tasty, healthy syrup from it. Finally, we’ll introduce you to our friend Kadriye who cooks up a typical Turkish lunch, and one of her neighbours demonstrates how to make the local pancake called gözleme.

programme.title: Food Sail Love
programme.desc: As our long voyage from Venice continues, we sail from Kastellorizo to Lindos on the island of Rhodes. This is where Patrick and I married, over 30 years ago. In Lindos, we take you to the Melenos kitchen; where the chef, Gogo, will show us her very modern & healthy take on traditional Greek cuisine. We visit Rhodes, where I used to teach ballet, and show you how to prepare artichokes with vinaigrette sauce, the dish that Patrick prepared for me on our very first date! Finally, we visit my godfather, Vangelis, who shows us how to prepare some authentic everyday Greek food.

programme.title: Food Sail Love
programme.desc: In this episode, we will take you to the beautiful Greek island of Symi, where the amphitheatrical harbour displays its distinctive neo classical architecture, very specific to this particular corner of the Aegean. Here we’ll recapture old memories, and cook the local delicacy - Symi shrimps. Our next stop is the extraordinary island of Santorini, where we will celebrate their famous tomatoes, grown in the rich volcanic soil. Finally, we head northwest to the mouth of the Corinth canal - the location of one of our all-time favourite seafood restaurants in the Mediterranean. It’s called Kavos and is run by Pagona and her son, Tassos.

programme.title: Food Sail Love
programme.desc: In this episode, we will sail through the Corinth canal in Greece, cross to the boot of Italy and sail all the way up the west coast to Liguria, to one of our favourite towns – Sestri Levante. On the way, we will stop at Galaxidi, halfway up the Gulf of Corinth, for breakfast after which I will prepare a Moussaka in the galley – under sail. We will then take you to Amalfi and the bay of Naples to pay homage to their lemons and to the Caprese salad, before arriving in the village of Sestri Levante to experience some delicious Ligurian dishes.

programme.title: Food Sail Love
programme.desc: In Portofino, we’ll be shown how to make the authentic version of pesto alla Genovese, by chef Corrado at the legendary Hotel Splendido. We will then visit the Canale bakery to see how they make the famous local bread called focaccia; and after that, we will meet up with my dear friend Nina on the yacht in Portofino’s iconic harbour, which is where we met over 25 years ago. She wants to show us how to make a couple of delicious dishes, in the galley.

programme.title: Food Sail Love
programme.desc: In this, the final episode, we sail along the French Riviera and catch up with some of the people and places we know and love. This region is particularly dear to Patrick; he was born in Marseille and spent all of his childhood summers on this coast. First, we’ll visit St Tropez, including the iconic Club 55; then we’ll take you to Antibes and to a couple of nearby villages, St Paul de Vence and Biot. Each has a restaurant which we count among our favourites, and they have two things in common – traditional Provençal food… and art, which in each case is largely its raison d’être.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Leonardo y Rebeca amanecen juntos y son sorprendidos por Coromoto y el personal doméstico. A continuación, Rebeca "abre" la situación ante todos e invita a los niños a pasar al cuarto a saludar a su padre. María Lucía se entera de que un benefactor misterioso pagó todas las cuotas de su colegiatura. Luego, al toparse con Julio en los pasillos de la universidad, él le confiesa que fue él. Irene recibe la visita de Paula en casa de Felipe y tienen una discusión tensa. Paula luego va a ver a Felipe al estudio y tergiversa los términos de la conversación. Felipe le pide que se vaya y los deje en paz. La investigación de Carlos Ernesto progresa gracias al esfuerzo de Juan Pablo, quien ha descubierto un extraño movimiento de los bienes de Rebeca mientras ella estaba supuestamente muerta.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Rebeca le hace una visita a Trinidad para dejarle la ropa de Irene y, de paso, humillarla. La mujer termina echándola de la casa prácticamente a patadas. Irene le comenta a Virginia que Felipe le ofreció ser el padre de su hijo por nacer y Virginia cuestiona la voluntad de su hermana de negarle la paternidad a Leonardo. Julio acude a casa de su abuela, Jimena, para interrogarla sobre su identidad. La mujer le da de largas y no contesta su pregunta.Juan Pablo va al motel donde Carlos Ernesto, Tony y Maribel esperan la hora de viajar al Caribe y le lleva los documentos. Por casualidad, Juan Pablo sube al auto de Carlos Ernesto y el mismo estalla en mil pedazos. Adolfo se congratula de lo bien que ha salido su plan.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Manuela intenta salvar su matrimonio con Ricardo mientras lidia con su rechazo hacia Elizabeth y las intrigas de Katiuska. Celia descubre que está embarazada y busca retener a Ricardo, quien impide que Manuela la enfrente. Entretanto, Moisés busca la verdad sobre su padre, y Marcelo enfrenta tensiones familiares tras su separación de Graciela. En medio de conflictos y secretos, Misael muestra interés por Manuela, mientras Katiuska sigue manipulando para separar a la pareja principal.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Ricardo enfrenta el acoso de Celia, quien le oculta su embarazo, mientras Manuela investiga a Misael. Moisés busca a su padre con apoyo de Elizabeth. Entre tensiones familiares y secretos, Ricardo teme perder a Manuela tras la llegada de Graciela. Benjamín sabotea a Rebeca y Verónica intenta seducir a Marcelo sin éxito. La Nonna se enfrenta a Katiuska para proteger la relación de su nieto, mientras los conflictos por el pasado y las herencias amenazan la estabilidad de todos.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: La Nonna se enfrenta a Katiuska por intentar separar a Ricardo y Manuela. Mientras Verónica seduce a Marcelo, Celia oculta su pasado y Elizabeth revela su nuevo embarazo, lo que amenaza el matrimonio de su padre. Katiuska sigue intrigando contra la pareja, manipulando pruebas y sembrando dudas sobre la amistad de Manuela con Misael, quien confiesa su amor por ella. Ricardo descubre que Misael y Donatella están casados, mientras Graciela busca soluciones para la infertilidad de Manuela.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Celia confirma su embarazo de Ricardo, desatando conflictos con Manuela y Juan Marcos. Katiuska manipula a Manuela y destruye pruebas legales, mientras Graciela oculta su infertilidad y sabotea romances ajenos. Brigitte escapa de rehabilitación e intenta seducir al padre Alejandro. Entre secretos sobre el pasado de sus padres e intrigas por herencias, los personajes enfrentan traiciones y decisiones desesperadas que ponen a prueba sus relaciones.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Katiuska manipula a Ricardo mientras Moisés busca la verdad sobre su padre. Manuela defiende a Misael ante Hortensia y sospecha estar embarazada. Tras un fuerte enfrentamiento entre Graciela y Celia por Ricardo, se revela el embarazo de esta última, lo que desata las intrigas de Katiuska. Finalmente, Moisés llega a casa de Celia ignorando que es su madre, mientras Benjamín lo busca desesperadamente tras su ausencia del liceo.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Rosa y Alejandro pasan la tarde íntima en un hotel; Rosalía y Junior descubren su ausencia furiosos. Adolfo contrata un detective con Consuelo para hallar a su hija. Eustoquio golpea brutalmente a José Luis por orden de Erasto. Maricela acepta unirse a Alcohólicos Anónimos con Alberto. Adolfo va a la tienda y le exige a Consuelo despedir a Rosa para proteger a Rosalía; Consuelo se niega. Consuelo e Isaías se topan con Maricela en una sesión y descubren que ella es la mujer con la que Isaías iba cuando se accidentó.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: José Luis llega golpeado a la residencia y acusa a Erasto. Blanca, al oírlo, expulsa a Natalia al confirmarla como amante de Erasto. Arminda y Eustoquio aterrorizan a Erasto disfrazándose de Benedicto para enloquecerlo. Isaías confiesa en voz alta su alcoholismo en la sesión. Salvador confiesa a Adolfo que siempre supo de la hija perdida. Alejandro se desahoga con Gualberto, quien le aconseja dejar a Rosalía. Junior incita a Rosalía y ella jura hacer algo que impedirá que Alejandro la deje, gestando lo que será su gran mentira.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Maricela pide a Alberto que le consiga un certificado de embarazo falso. Erasto humilla a Natalia llevándola a su propia casa frente a Arminda. Alejandro intenta romper con Rosalía, pero ella le muestra el certificado de embarazo falso, paralizando su decisión. Adolfo promete a Consuelo seguir buscando a su hija. programme.desc: Alejandro deja que Sol le tome una prueba de ADN para comprobar si es el padre de Esperanza, agregando además la condición de que ella haga esas pruebas en un laboratorio sin que él no sepa, para así no tener chance de adulterar los resultados. Luego, Sol y Alejandro se reencuentran, y aunque Alejandro insiste en no ser el padre de Esperanza, Sol le confirma que nunca ha estado con otro hombre que no sea él. programme.desc: Doroteo confiesa a María José que está deprimido por La Nena. Santiago defiende ferozmente a Luis Fernando y le provoca para que se decida a recuperar a un verdadero amigo. Yesenia se desmaya al escuchar la propuesta de matrimonio de Marco Aurelio.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Katiuska manipula a Ricardo mientras Moisés busca la verdad sobre su padre. Manuela defiende a Misael ante Hortensia y sospecha estar embarazada. Tras un fuerte enfrentamiento entre Graciela y Celia por Ricardo, se revela el embarazo de esta última, lo que desata las intrigas de Katiuska. Finalmente, Moisés llega a casa de Celia ignorando que es su madre, mientras Benjamín lo busca desesperadamente tras su ausencia del liceo.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Erasto cuenta a Marisela en la clínica todo sobre Consuelo y la hija perdida, incitándola a vengarse. Marisela enfrenta a Adolfo delante de Junior y Andreína, jurándolo públicamente. Alejandro entrega a Rosa los 500 mil bolívares del marcapasos. Adolfo exige a Alejandro cumplir con Rosalía. Eustoquio se queda frío: el cheque del comprador de dólares es rechazado por el banco. Erasto recibe una citación de la PTJ. Junior consuela a Rosa mientras Alejandro lucha por mantener su promesa de casarse con Rosalía.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Rebeca le hace una visita a Trinidad para dejarle la ropa de Irene y, de paso, humillarla. La mujer termina echándola de la casa prácticamente a patadas. Irene le comenta a Virginia que Felipe le ofreció ser el padre de su hijo por nacer y Virginia cuestiona la voluntad de su hermana de negarle la paternidad a Leonardo. Julio acude a casa de su abuela, Jimena, para interrogarla sobre su identidad. La mujer le da de largas y no contesta su pregunta.Juan Pablo va al motel donde Carlos Ernesto, Tony y Maribel esperan la hora de viajar al Caribe y le lleva los documentos. Por casualidad, Juan Pablo sube al auto de Carlos Ernesto y el mismo estalla en mil pedazos. Adolfo se congratula de lo bien que ha salido su plan.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Alejandro deja que Sol le tome una prueba de ADN para comprobar si es el padre de Esperanza, agregando además la condición de que ella haga esas pruebas en un laboratorio sin que él no sepa, para así no tener chance de adulterar los resultados. Luego, Sol y Alejandro se reencuentran, y aunque Alejandro insiste en no ser el padre de Esperanza, Sol le confirma que nunca ha estado con otro hombre que no sea él. Él la besa a la fuerza, pero llega Alejandrito y deben separarse.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Graciela llorando le pide disculpas a Atanasio y le dice que no lo volverá a molestar ni a él ni a su esposa. Atanasio también con los ojos enrojecidos | le pide disculpas a ella Bienvenida le dice unas cuentas cosas a Solymar por lo de Graciela Gisela comienza a hablarle a Atanasio de la gente que está en el restaurante. Atanasio obstinado le dice que se vayan y ella acepta. Segundo le dice a ROKUro que le gusta Carolina pero que ella nunca aceptará a un taxista.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: La familia Ferrandiz se encuentra muy conmovida por la muerte del Licenciado Finol, Leonardo, preocupado, decide ponerle seguridad a toda la familia, ya que está seguro de que la muerte de su compañero no fue un accidente, si no un atentado contra ellos. De esa manera busca incansablemente a Irene, que finalmente la encuentra con Felipe y le comenta que iniciará las acciones legales para anular su matrimonio. Agustina la escucha a Rebeca hablar con Adolfo sobre lo molesto que es Carlos Ernesto para su plan. Ella, preocupada, decide ir a la casa de Jimena y comentarle todos los problemas que hay en la casa de Leonardo, pero primero Carlos Ernesto le muestra unos papeles de las propiedades de Rebeca que fueron vendidas mientras ella estaba fallecida.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Alejandro lleva a Sol a una playa desierta y le confiesa su amor y ganas de estar con ella, pero Sol no le cree nada de lo que le dice. Heriberto se da cuenta de los planes de Alejandro y piensa que será él quien termine “jugando” con el. Carlos y Maricielo se encuentran en una plaza y se sinceran, confiesan su amor el uno por el otro. Pero saben que no pueden hacer lo que el corazón les dicta porque pesa la conciencia sobre sus cabezas, pensando que Alicia y Víctor Hugo son buenas personas.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Briggite y Junior totalmente tomados hablan casi sin entenderse de la película que va a filmar. Se besan y están juntos. Jesica sigue furiosa esperando a Junior pensando lo peor | que por su edad y la emoción de la película se haya muerto. Bienvenida le da ánimos a Graciela por lo que pasó con Anastasio. Gisela trata de averiguar con Armando quien es la joven por la cual se siente tan mal. Fabián y Finita tienen tremenda discusión por sexo. Wilker está cantando y lo está viendo Solymar.

programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores
programme.desc: Dileidy deja claro a Luis Fernando que, a pesar de su separación, no está disponible para él. Edén declara su amor a Pascuita. María Antonia echa a Paco de su casa. Gonzalo planea irse a vivir con Tatiana pero Paco estropea sus planes.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Manuela y Ricardo disfrutan su reconciliación, mientras Celia ayuda a Moisés a esconderse de Néstor. Ricardo confronta a Celia por su embarazo, rechazando al bebé y negándole su apellido por amor a Manuela. Graciela descubre a Ricardo en casa de Celia y planea delatarlo. Por otro lado, Manuela descubre que está embarazada y celebra con su familia. Hortensia intenta alejar a Misael con dinero, y Moisés busca alejarse de Néstor para proteger su nueva vida.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Marisela grita a Adolfo todo el pasado con Consuelo delante de Junior y Andreína. René, Mariela y Mildred hacen colecta callejera para Carmen pero unos malandros se la roban. Eustoquio amenaza a Isaías por la estafa de los dólares. Adolfo reclama a Erasto por contarle todo a Marisela; Erasto lo expulsa. Natalia decide huir de Erasto y José Luis se ofrece a ayudarla. Rosalía enfrenta furiosa a Consuelo en la tienda exigiendo explicaciones sobre Adolfo. Carmen supera la crisis y Rosa logra verla en cuidados intensivos.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Alejandra le pide a Tony que le ponga un aviso a la credencial de entrada a la empresa a Irene, por lo que cuando Irene se presentó a la empresa para poder cobrar su liquidación final Alejandra la cita en su oficina y la trata de una manera muy hiriente. Rebeca contrata a una nueva secretaria para Leonardo para que la mantenga informada sobre todos los movimientos de él en la empresa. María Lucía va a los tribunales para poder averiguar quién fue la persona que le pidió la prueba de paternidad. A no conseguir ninguna información se acerca a la casa de Zulay para pedirle que haga un esfuerzo y le diga el nombre de su verdadero padre. Adolfo, Rebeca y Rodrigo plantan una información falsa de que el atentado contra Juan Pablo que acabó con su muerte fue una maniobra armada por los Samora.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Sol y Alejandro están en la playa desierta, comienzan a besarse y se confiesan su amor. Luego se van al yate y se quedan ahí hasta que unos ladrones entran y golpean a Sol. Luego uno de ellos le dispara a quemarropa a Alejandro. Columba y Eloy van a hablar con Maricielo, quien les dice que no los perdona. Luego se encuentran con José Domingo y le dicen que tienen que hablar algo con él acerca de Maricielo pero José Domingo se pone ansioso, y Eloy y Columba parecen arrepentidos.

programme.title: Apocalipsis en Los Ángeles
programme.desc: Se detecta actividad volcánica en el núcleo de la Tierra y los científicos descubren que la ciudad de Los Ángeles está a punto de ser borrada del mapa. Mientras el área es evacuada, un hombre vuelve a la ciudad para encontrar a su novia, pero descubre que ha sido secuestrada.

programme.desc: Theodore Roosevelt se enfrenta a un recio vecino que pretende apoderarse de su recién construido Rancho Elkhorn a través del fraude.

programme.title: Elkhorn
programme.desc: Cuando Theodore Roosevelt se une a unos justicieros para cazar a unos ladrones de caballos, aprende que la justicia no siempre es justa.

programme.title: Elkhorn
programme.desc: Cuando la salud de Theodore Roosevelt va de mal en peor, el encargado de su rancho debe ir a un poblado Siux para hallar una cura urgente.

programme.title: Elkhorn
programme.desc: Theodore Roosevelt emprende una cacería en las montañas Bighorn de Wyoming, donde se encuentra cara a cara con un oso devorador de hombres.

programme.title: Elkhorn
programme.desc: Cuando un bandido enmascarado aterra a los carruajes, Theodore Roosevelt y sus hombres se unen a la gente de Medora para hallar al culpable.

programme.desc: Una niña rebelde es enviada a pasar la Navidad en el rancho de caballos de su abuela. Se hace amiga del pony de su abuela y se decide a ayudar a salvar el rancho de la ejecución hipotecaria.

programme.title: Historias Para No Dormir

programme.title: Todo es Silencio
programme.desc: En Brétema, en la costa atlántica, hubo una época en la que las redes de contrabando, narcotráfico convertidas, alcanzaron tanta influencia que estuvieron cerca de controlarlo todo: el poder social, las instituciones, la vida de su gente. Fins, Leda y Frink exploran la costa en busca de lo que les depara el mar tras un naufragio, el mar es para ellos un lugar de continuo descubrimiento.
